title: Jacobi symbol in a residue ring
statement: For each natural number $N$ and each residue class $x$ modulo $N$, let $r$ be the least nonnegative integer representative of $x$. The defined residue class modulo $N$ is the Jacobi symbol of $r$ with modulus $N$, reduced modulo $N$.
